name: gNMIc
what_it_is: gNMIc is a gNMI CLI client and telemetry collector that executes Capabilities, Get, Set, and Subscribe RPCs against network devices over gRPC. It supports multiple output backends, clustering, data pipelines, and dynamic target discovery.
configuration: output backends (NATS, Kafka, Prometheus, InfluxDB, prototext)
constraints: requires gNMI-capable target devices (gRPC endpoint must be reachable)
dial-out server for Nokia SR OS is vendor-specific and not universally applicable
no docker-compose file found in repository (main and master branches)
notable_absences: no built-in dashboard or UI (relies on external tools like Grafana)
